All 48 task attempts passed, but source drift detected after strengthening same-label parent/child geometry validation. Excluded from primary validation.

limitations: Scripted native actions with independent synthetic app state; no real-model planning or production-app reliability claim.
The original 1.0.0 baseline has one repetition; the 1.1.0 candidate has three and stricter field verification. Timing comparison is descriptive, not a matched release comparison.
No automatic foreground fallback or retry after uncertain input was added.
Six keyboard cases and six button-deduplication cases passed; these are not coverage of every third-party foreground/background behavior.
